intro: At mdigimart, we are committed to ensuring that your orders reach you safely and on time. Please read our shipping policy carefully to understand how deliveries are handled on our platform.

content.text: At mdigimart, we are committed to ensuring that your orders reach you safely and on time. Please read our shipping policy carefully to understand how deliveries are handled on our platform.

All shipping and delivery operations on mdigimart are managed through our authorized delivery agents. mdigimart is a platform that connects retailers and consumers and supports the order flow, while shipping, handling, packaging, and delivery are coordinated through the assigned agents.

items: mdigimart does not ship products directly. It is a platform that connects retailers and consumers while assigned agents coordinate order delivery.
All logistics responsibilities — including order pickup, packaging, transit, and final delivery — are handled entirely by the assigned agents.
mdigimart is not responsible for delays, damages, losses, or errors that occur during the shipping process, as these are handled by the respective agents.

content.text: The agent assigned to your order is fully responsible for the following activities:

items: Order Pickup — Collecting the product from the seller or warehouse.
Packaging & Handling — Ensuring the product is safely packed for transit.
Shipping & Transit — Transporting the product to your delivery address.
Last-Mile Delivery — Delivering the order to your doorstep.
Proof of Delivery — Providing delivery confirmation upon successful handover.
Failed Delivery Attempts — Managing re-delivery schedules if the customer is unavailable.

items.text: Important: Assigned agents are responsible for taking care of pickup, packaging, shipment coordination, transit handling, and final delivery-related activities for the order.

content.text: Shipping timelines are determined and communicated by the agent at the time of order confirmation. Delivery is generally scheduled after 3 days of successful payment being received, subject to product readiness, agent scheduling, and logistics availability.

items.text: Important: Shipping will be done after 3 days of successful payment being received, based on operational readiness and delivery planning.

content.text: Shipping fees, if applicable, are set by the respective agents. mdigimart does not collect, control, or regulate any shipping charges. Any shipping-related fees will be clearly communicated to you by the agent before or at the time of order placement.

Order tracking, if available, will be provided directly by the agent. mdigimart does not have access to real-time shipment tracking data and is unable to provide shipping updates on behalf of any agent.
In the event of a damaged, lost, or undelivered order:

items: The matter must be raised directly with the assigned agent, as they hold full responsibility for the shipment.
mdigimart can assist in facilitating communication between the customer and the agent but cannot be held responsible for any shipping-related disputes, losses, or damages.

content.text: mdigimart is a digital platform that connects retailers and consumers. The platform does not directly perform the physical movement of goods. All shipping operations, commitments, and delivery responsibilities rest with the assigned agents. By placing an order on mdigimart, you acknowledge and agree that shipping execution is managed through the assigned delivery agents.
